summary: Engineering preview: every retained old screen now routes through native Instrument Teal parameter, list, grid, name/confirmation and result families, including advanced FM6/VA, Layer, effects, recordings, system, diagnostics and recovery. HOME/banks, Groove/Loop/Mix/Click and the protected sixteen-slot editor retain their existing musical owners. Finite chord/cursor/knob/bank/workspace/focus/save transitions and a real post-MASTER output-driven halo share the single On/Off setting; Off cancels visual work and settled views skip rendering. The current manual-take/latest-three policy remains intact. Chord Lab adds Now/Last/planned-slot notes and intervals, fixed-context comparisons, offline Next suggestions, explicit one-bar audition and undoable insertion. Songs now adds six saved semantic ideas and existing recording rows, protected quiet-boundary writes, complete musical snapshots, progression rename/duplicate/delete and recording load/delete. SAVE opens Songs; SELECT Save current then SEL creates a new copy. Full arranged recording, recording rename/duplicate, bulk clear and physical verification remain pending. Chord library/audition remains explicitly deferred. See docs/SONGS-LIBRARY.md for native preview controls and limits. CORD now supplies the selected piano-key/ring boot in three saved themes; HOME fixes cross-clock freshness and clipped ellipses, adds accepted-beat header activity and lights live progression matches.
